logline: When Rupert frantically orders Alexander's arrest, the royal guards refuse and salute the true Duke, before damning Crown intelligence documents expose Rupert and Lord Sterling's treasonous plot.
continuity_notes: Follows directly from Episode 42; inside the ruined cathedral, Alexander confronts Rupert before the congregation, armed with evidence from the Crown to reclaim his rightful title.

blocks.text: Medium close-up on Rupert Ashburn standing before the altar, trembling with mounting panic and rage.

blocks.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
blocks.text: "You're lying!"
Rupert lunges forward, his facial features contorting in venomous desperation.
Tracking shot swinging around Rupert as he turns toward the royal guards stationed along the aisle, pointing furiously down the center of the hall.

blocks.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
blocks.text: "This man is an imposter! Arrest him!"
Wide symmetrical shot framing Alexander Ashburn standing immovable in the center of the cathedral, flanking lines of red-coated guards on both sides.
Alexander stands completely composed in his dark embroidered aristocratic coat, staring Rupert down with unyielding authority.
Extreme close-up on Rupert's furious face, veins bulging at his temples.

blocks.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
blocks.text: "I said arrest him!"
Medium shot on the Royal Guard Captain in ceremonial bearskin uniform standing steadfast.
The Guard Captain brings his ceremonial sword upright to attention, his expression stern and resolute.

blocks.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
blocks.text: "We will not."
Low-angle shot looking down along the polished stone floor as the guard's sword tip grounds firmly between Rupert and the guards.

blocks.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
blocks.text: "I am Lord Rupert Ashburn!"
Medium close-up on Rupert thumping his chest in indignant disbelief.

blocks.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
blocks.text: "Your Duke!"
Medium shot framing the Guard Captain and Alexander in profile.
The Guard Captain snaps a crisp salute toward Alexander.

blocks.speaker: ROYAL GUARD
blocks.text: "No. He is your Duke."
Medium shot on Catherine in her bridal gown and Lord Henry Sterling seated in the front pew, both frozen in stunned shock.
Lord Sterling clutches his gold-headed walking cane tightly, his jaw clenching as tension spreads through the church.
Medium shot on Rupert spinning toward the gathered congregation, his hands flailing.

blocks.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
blocks.text: "You have all been deceived!"
Medium close-up on Alexander, commanding and icy.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "Then let the Crown decide."
Close-up on Alexander's hands holding an official War Office document bundle sealed with red wax and ribbon.
Alexander brings forth the dossier stamped "WAR OFFICE - TOP SECRET" with the royal crest.
Medium shot of Alexander holding up the sealed parcel before the room.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "These were delivered to me under the seal of the Crown."

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "Read the first."
Close-up on Lord Sterling looking sideways, his face pale with rising dread.
Two-shot of Alexander handing the dossier to a Crown Military Magistrate wearing white gloves and a high-collared black uniform.
The Crown Official receives the dossier solemnly with both hands.
Medium close-up on the Crown Official opening the binder and reading aloud.
Crisp sound of parchment turning.

blocks.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
blocks.text: "Military Intelligence Report, Iberian front, three years ago."
Close-up on Rupert staring wide-eyed, completely petrified.
Medium close-up on the Crown Official continuing the official reading.

blocks.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
blocks.text: "Duke Alexander Ashburn's unit was ambushed after his location was compromised."
Frontal medium shot of the Crown Official turning a page as the congregation listens in breathless silence.

blocks.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
blocks.text: "The report identifies the leak as deliberate."
Wide shot across the rubble of the cathedral floor showing Rupert crumbling in fear against the choir railing.

blocks.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
blocks.text: "Information regarding the Duke's position was transmitted through British channels."
Rupert staggers backward, his knees buckling as he leans his weight heavily on the stone balustrade.
Close-up on Rupert clinging to the stone pillar, his breath shallow and terrified.
Medium shot on Alexander stepping forward, thrusting the secondary dossier forward.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "Read the names."
Medium close-up on the Crown Official reading the concluding section.

blocks.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
blocks.text: "Lord Henry Sterling."
Quick pan to Lord Sterling stiffening in his pew, then the Crown Official.

blocks.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
blocks.text: "Rupert Ashburn."
Extreme close-up on Rupert's horrified eyes darting in sheer terror.
Close-up on the Dowager Duchess covering her mouth in agonizing disbelief.

blocks.speaker: DOWAGER DUCHESS
blocks.text: "My God..."
Low-angle shot on Alexander towering over the fallen Rupert.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "You sold my men to the enemy."
Close-up on Rupert waving his hands defensively, hyperventilating.

blocks.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
blocks.text: "I didn't!"
Low-angle tracking push-in on Alexander raising the red-ribboned war document toward the cathedral arches.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "And when you believed I was dead..."
Quick reaction shot on Rupert gasping on the steps.
Tight close-up on Alexander's scarred, furious face.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "You took my title."
Extreme close-up on the Crown Official's gloved thumb cracking the red wax seal open.
Brittle snap of breaking sealing wax.
Full shot of the Crown Official standing amidst church debris reading the death register.

blocks.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
blocks.text: "Official death confirmation was filed three months after the ambush."
Two-shot of the Crown Official in the background and Alexander's dark silhouette in the foreground.

blocks.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
blocks.text: "Duke Alexander Ashburn was declared dead."
Wide majestic shot capturing the entire nave, the rows of horrified guests, and the ruined cathedral windows.

blocks.speaker: CROWN OFFICIAL
blocks.text: "His estate and title were subsequently transferred under false authority."
Medium close-up on Rupert clutching his chest as if choking on his own lies.

blocks.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
blocks.text: "I was told he was dead!"
Low shot following Alexander's heavy boots stepping steadily up the stone steps toward the altar.

blocks.speaker: ALEXANDER
blocks.text: "You were told exactly what you needed to hear."
Medium shot on Rupert whirling around in a frenzy, pointing his finger toward Lord Sterling.

blocks.speaker: BLOND NOBLEMAN
blocks.text: "Sterling handled the report!"
Alexander turns his head sharply toward the side pews.
Medium shot of Lord Henry Sterling silently slipping out of his seat and making a break toward the side exit.
Close-up on Catherine peering out from under her bridal veil in shock.

blocks.speaker: CATHERINE
blocks.text: "My Lord?"
Medium shot of Lord Sterling frantically unlatching the heavy oak church door and pulling it open.
Heavy iron latch clicking open and wooden door creaking.
Reverse angle from inside the doorway showing a stern British Police Constable standing directly outside, blocking the passage.

blocks.speaker: POLICE CONSTABLE
blocks.text: "Going somewhere, Lord Sterling?"
Extreme close-up on Lord Sterling's face frozen in pure terror, his jaw agape as his escape is completely cut off, holding until fade to black.
